cli.help.page.wizard:
Interactive pack wizard

Usage:
  greentic-pack wizard
  greentic-pack wizard run [OPTIONS]
  greentic-pack wizard validate --answers <FILE> [OPTIONS]
  greentic-pack wizard apply --answers <FILE> [OPTIONS]

Common options:
  --locale <LOCALE>        CLI/wizard aru ajlliña (amuyt'añataki: en, en-GB, nl)

Run options:
  --answers <FILE>         AnswerDocument apthapiña ukhamaraki no interactivo apply flow apnaqaña
  --emit-answers <FILE>    run qhipa AnswerDocument qillqaña
  --schema-version <VER>   emit/migration ukataki schema versión objetivo
  --migrate                auto-migration jaytaña kunapachatixa schema metadata chhaqha jan ukaxa nayrïr ukhaxa
  --dry-run                ajllitanaka qillqt'aña ukhamaraki answers mistuyaña jan side effects ukanakampi

`wizard` (subcommand jan utjkani ukhaxa) interactivo menú principal apnaqi.
